stem: What happens next in this passage after “She spoke slowly, and every word was easy to understand.”?
options: Trash from one beach told a story about many different places.
They talk about tests, club activities, lost items, and lunch menus.
Another wrote about soup his father cooked when someone was sick.
Her story was about learning to talk to her sick grandfather.
